business_summary: Euronet Worldwide, Inc. provides payment and transaction processing and distribution solutions to financial institutions, retailers, service providers, and individual consumers internationally. The company operates through three segments: Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT), epay, and Money Transfer. The EFT segment provides automated teller machine cash withdrawal and deposit services, ATM network participation, outsourced ATM and point-of-sale (POS) management solutions, credit and debit and prepaid card outsourcing, card issuing, and merchant acquiring services. It also offers ATM and POS dynamic currency conversion, domestic and international surcharge, foreign currency dispensing, advertising, digital content sales at ATMs, customer relationship management, prepaid mobile top-up, bill payment, money transfer, fraud management, foreign remittance payout, cardless payout, banknote recycling solutions, and tax-refund services; and integrated electronic financial transaction software solutions for electronic payment and transaction delivery systems. The epay segment distributes and processes prepaid mobile airtime and other electronic content and payment processing services for various prepaid products, cards, and services. The Money Transfer segment offers consumer-to-consumer money transfer services through a network of locations and its website riamoneytransfer.com; account-to-account money transfer; and money transfer services through its website xe.com, Xe app, and customer service representatives. It also provides foreign currency exchange information on its currency data websites xe.com and x-rates.com; cash management solutions and foreign currency risk management services to small-and-medium-sized businesses; and payment processing services to third-party partners. The company was formerly known as Euronet Services, Inc. and changed its name to Euronet Worldwide, Inc. in August 2001. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Leawood, Kansas.
business_summary_ko: Euronet Worldwide, Inc.는 국제적으로 금융 기관, 소매업체, 서비스 제공업체 및 개인 소비자에게 결제, 거래 처리 및 유통 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 전자 자금 이체(EFT), epay 및 송금의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. EFT 부문은 현금 자동 입출금 및 예금 서비스, ATM 네트워크 참여, 아웃소싱 ATM 및 POS(Point-of-Sale) 관리 솔루션, 신용 카드 및 직불 카드 및 선불 카드 아웃소싱, 카드 발급 및 가맹점 획득 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 ATM 및 POS 동적 통화 변환, 국내 및 국제 할증료, 외화 지급, 광고, ATM에서의 디지털 콘텐츠 판매, 고객 관계 관리, 선불 모바일 충전, 청구서 지불, 송금, 사기 관리, 해외 송금 지불, 카드 없는 지불, 지폐 재활용 솔루션 및 세금 환급 서비스를 제공합니다. 전자지불 및 거래전달시스템을 위한 통합전자금융거래 소프트웨어 솔루션 등을 제공합니다. epay 부문은 선불 모바일 방송 시간 및 기타 전자 콘텐츠와 다양한 결제 처리 서비스를 배포하고 처리합니다.
